articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether benefit as traders seek safety of largest tokens
articles.snippet: The two largest cryptocurrencies are the only CoinDesk 20 members in positive territory as altcoins fall out of favor.

articles.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
articles.snippet: Federal prosecutors say Taj Tarsha misled backers and used investor funds for personal expenses.

articles.title: Blockchain.com wins Cayman custody license after MiCA and FCA approvals
articles.snippet: Blockchain.com secured a VASP custody license from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority, expanding its regulated crypto services in the region.

articles.title: EU watchdogs warn of impersonation scams amid MiCA licensing shakeout
articles.snippet: Criminals are reportedly using fake websites and falsified documents to target customers searching for licensed crypto providers.
